boundaryEffects: Conversion configs must explicitly name their runtime pipeline; source architecture names no longer leak into modelType.
13 previously incomplete conversion configs now declare transformer or gemma4.
No inference default, arithmetic kernel, catalog qualification, or deployment changed.

correctness.weights: Both F16 engines use pinned mirror source weights cast to F16.
correctness.sourceMirrorCaveat: Identity is pinned to unsloth/gemma-3-270m-it; byte identity with original Google hosting was not independently established.
correctness.scope: Two repeated synthetic document-continuation prompts, not an application-quality evaluation.
correctness.computeCaveat: Doppler uses explicit F32 activations and F16 KV; MLX uses native F16 parameters/activations. This is a weight-matched diagnostic, not identical internal arithmetic or a claimable vendor ranking.

performance.claim: Sequential diagnostic, two timed repetitions per length; not an interleaved performance ranking.
performance.timingBoundary: Prompt-to-first delivered token; decode uses 127 delivery intervals for 128 tokens. Includes orchestration; not pure GPU time.

batch4Candidate.interpretation: Four-token batch candidate reduces observed wall time, but remains slower than MLX. No default promotion from two sequential timing samples.

packedResidency.interpretation: Same stored Q4K bytes; candidate retains packed projection buffers. F16 embedding/head dominates remaining storage. Candidate is slower, and per-layer numerical/quality qualification remains required.

largerModel.interpretation: Existing text-only Q4K policy exceeds physical memory before caches, activations, CPU copies and OS. Further quantization must be qualified before a resident 27B attempt.

priorEvidenceCorrection.scope: Cannot establish realistic long-context prefill performance.

nextRequiredProof: Qualify lower-bit linear-attention projections and/or embedding/head for 27B memory fit.
